articles.summary: Milwaukee Journal Sentinel Recognizes Douglas Dynamics in Top 15 for Medium-sized Companies MILWAUKEE, WI (May 2, 2022)—Douglas Dynamics, Inc. (NYSE: PLOW), North America’s premier manufacturer and upfitter of commercial work truck attachments and equipment, announced today it has been recognized as a Top Workplace for the 13th consecutive year by the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel.
